qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Eastern freight rail duopoly with CSX provides irreplaceable physical right-of-way infrastructure and pricing power consistently at or above inflation (+2-4% pricing spread). High barriers prevent arbitrage, but intermodal faces modal competition from long-haul trucking and coal faces secular volume decline.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (N, REJECT). Irreplaceable Eastern freight rail infrastructure network with duopoly pricing power, but fails Munger quality standards due to structural capital intensity (8-year FCF conversion 74% vs. >=80% threshold), 10.5% 10-year median ROIC, and an overleveraged balance sheet ($16.5B LT debt vs. $2.87B NI, 5.74x leverage vs. <=4.0x hurdle). [5-10Y g: volume 1.0% + price 2.5% + operating ratio recovery 1.0% + share repurchases 2.0%]
qualitative.evidence: Norfolk Southern operates ~19,300 route miles across 22 Eastern states, forming an essential freight rail duopoly with CSX. Pre-disaster ROIC was 12.5-13.5% (2021-2022), but 10-year median ROIC is 10.5%, reflecting the heavy capital requirements of rail maintenance. In 2025, operating revenue was ~$12.2B, EBIT was $4,356M, interest expense was $792M (5.5x coverage, down from pre-2023 levels and dipping to 3.95x in 2023), and GAAP net income was $2,873M (still below the 2022 peak of $3,270M). Free cash flow was $2,157M in 2025, $1,671M in 2024, and $852M in 2023, against net income of $2,873M, $2,622M, and $1,827M respectively (3-year FCF conversion 63.9%; 8-year conversion 74.1%), falling short of the >=80% FCF conversion requirement due to $2.2B-$2.4B annual capex additions. Balance sheet carries $16,480M long-term debt and $607M current debt against $1,530M cash, yielding 5.74x LT debt to net income, breaching the <=4.0x peace-of-mind threshold. Calamity tier is denied because the leverage and low cash conversion are multi-cycle structural characteristics of the business model rather than temporary artifacts of the 2023 East Palestine derailment.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
